static: harsh analog VHS tape static, loud white noise hiss with crackle and a low hum, a tape ending on a blank channel
glitch: a very short VHS tape tracking glitch: a warbling distorted electrical crackle and a brief buzz
mall_hum: an empty shopping mall at night, low steady air conditioning drone and faint fluorescent light hum, no people, no music, no footsteps, loopable
tape_hiss: constant soft analog videotape hiss and faint mechanical motor whir, steady, loopable
breath: one slow quiet human exhale very close to a microphone, muffled, no voice
projector: the steady fan hum and faint electrical buzz of a video projector in an empty cinema auditorium, loopable, no music, no voices
door: a heavy padded cinema door slowly swinging shut by itself, a long low creak and a soft thud
seat: a folding cinema seat being pushed down as someone sits, a slow creak of old springs, in a large empty room
bone_creak: a slow stiff neck turning one notch: a deep dry creak of bone and cartilage with small gritty clicks, very close, in a silent room, no voice
bone_crack: one single loud deep dry crack, like a huge knuckle or a stiff joint cracking hard, short gristly creak after it, very close, no voice
projector_down: an old video projector switching off in an empty cinema: a relay click, the lamp ticking, the cooling fan slowly winding down to silence
vcr_clunk: a 1990s VCR jog shuttle control: one hard mechanical clunk and a quick whir of the tape heads
lamp_tick: a projector lamp flickering for an instant: a short electrical crackle and a buzzing dropout
chime: an old 1990s shopping mall public address chime, three slow descending electronic tones from ceiling speakers, slightly warped tape, empty hall echo
